subject: Quarterline checkpoint: action grid & unblock asks
messages:
From: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quarterline checkpoint: action grid & unblock asks

Good morning team —

Quick mid-window check here ahead of next week’s QBR prep. I attached the current OKR heatmap and a dependency matrix (v3) — both pulled from the tracker this morning. High-level status:

- Serving runtime OKR: 62% -> still behind on kernel selection work but tracker shows steady progress.
- Dedicated availability: 78% -> infra provisioning is in flight but we need definitive capacity for canary in EU by Nov 1.
- Optimize toolkit: 45% -> quantization experiments are producing variance; we should consider a controlled rescope to keep the MVP stable.

Asks for this thread (action grid):
1) Vanessa — can you confirm whether we can shift two infra FTEs (infra-prod team) to the dedicated pool for three weeks starting Oct 25? That unblock buys the EU canary window.
2) Marissa — propose a concrete rescope for Optimize so we can ship an initial set of recommendations without the full quant pipeline (suggested bullets in attachment).
3) Markus + Laura — we need a single-slide exec readout summarizing the tradeoff (latency vs. cost) and the fallback plan if EU capacity slips.

I recommend we lock the decision by EOD Monday; if we miss that window, we risk slipping the QBR narrative. Meeting to align: I added a 30-min slot (link below).

Thanks —
Jasmine

Attachments: okr-status-heatmap.xlsx (attachment), dependency-matrix-v3.csv (attachment)
Calendar: https://calendar.company.com/event/5G8KQ-Quarterline-Checkpoint

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2026 09:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarterline checkpoint: action grid & unblock asks

Thanks Jasmine — good snapshot. Quick notes from infra:

- We can reprioritize two infra-prod FTEs for three weeks, but that requires approval from Platform Ops (they flagged several network maintenance windows this month). My ask: confirm the exact VM/GPU SKU and region pair we need; if we require A100 EU-west, lead time is 7 days; if we can accept a mixed-quant/8-bit profile on existing nodes, lead time is 48 hours.

- Security/compliance gating: we still have the outstanding SOC evidence request from ACME (Sarah Park). If ACME tasks aren’t cleared by Oct 28 we cannot enable customer-specific VPCs for the canary. I’ll loop Legal if we need expedited review.

Action items I can own this week:
- Work with procurement to surface SKU options (ETA: Mon 10/25 noon).
- Triage SOC evidence with Laura (Laura, can you confirm who owns the ACME responses?).

Forwarding Jasmine’s attachment suggestions inline for clarity.

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Cc: markus.klein@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarterline checkpoint: action grid & unblock asks

Agree with the ask and trying to be pragmatic on scope. Proposed rescope for Optimize (MVP):

- Ship: batching recommendations + static quantization guide + model selector heuristics.
- Defer: dynamic quant pipeline and per-customer continuous evals until next quarter.
- Impact: reduces engineering effort by ~40% and keeps the initial customer-facing recommendations consistent.

Dependencies I need:
- Two infra FTEs for test cluster capacity (Vanessa’s note) — otherwise I can only validate on limited scale.
- A prioritized prompt set from CS for regression checks (Laura, can CS share the top 25 prompts by next Tue?).

If we commit to this rescope, I can produce a rollout plan and QA checklist by Tues EOD. I’ll attach a short one-pager to the tracker.

Thanks all — appreciate the crisp asks. High-level:

- I approve the temporary FTE swap contingent on Vanessa getting procurement confirmation for the mixed-node profile (48-hour path preferred).
- For the QBR slide: please give me one slide that states the decision, the expected delta to latency/cost, and the fallback (two bullets). I’ll refine for the exec readout.
- Laura, please escalate the SOC evidence items where needed; we can loop in Legal by EOD Monday if it remains open.
